title: Bernie Young band sidemen: Cassino Simpson, Quinn Wilson, McKendrick, Jackson
summary: Randolph names the pianists, bassists and others who passed through Young's band and talks about meeting McKendrick and Preston Jackson there.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Weren't a lot of the musicians in that band from Chicago? Was Cassino Simpson in the band when you were -- piano player?

Oh, Cass? Cassino Simpson? Yes, Cassino Simpson was in the band and we sent -- then we changed -- we got a different -- we had a different line up because we had Cassino Simpson -- then we had Cassino Simpson. We kept Cass, we sent and got Burroughs Lovinggood --
MEMORABLE ERASABLE COTTON CONTENT
Oh, the piano player.
The piano player.
That you mentioned earlier.
Uh-huh. Then we had -- we got Winston Walker on bass.
Brass bass.
Yeah. We had Quinn Wilson. Now, Quinn Wilson was on bass when I joined the band.
Oh, yes.
We called him Doc Eggy.
I know Quinn.
Quinn, yes.
I played with him quite often.
Yes, Quinn, yes.
Wonderful man.
You know Mike passed?
Mike McKendrick?
Mike McKendrick, yes. He passed. He was good with Bill Reinhardt.
Yeah. Was that Big Mike? Big Mike was -- yeah, then there was Little Mike.
Little Mike -- no, this was -- Little Mike -- yeah, that's right. Little Mike was -- Big Mike -- all I know. Mike McKendrick -- I don't know which was --
I think usually when they say Mike
McKendrick they mean Big Mike -- it's not important.
Yeah, uh-huh.
But he was in the Bernie Young band too?
Yes, he was with Bernie Young, that's where I met Mike McKendrick and Preston Jackson.
Preston was in it too?
Yeah, Preston was in the band.
I saw Preston about six months ago. He went back to New Orleans?
Yeah, he's down in New Orleans now.

Yeah. Oh, yes, to be up there in that age he plays, doesn't he?
Yes, he does.
Yeah. He's got it on me. I guess I've fooled with so many --
